scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/api run seed --
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace packages/shared run test && npm --workspace apps/api run test
